captions.detailed: This is a vintage banker's desk lamp featuring a flat, circular cast-iron base in black, a short vertical brass post, an adjustable brass arm, and a classic green glass dome shade. The lamp has two points of articulation: the main arm pivots up and down on a revolute joint at the top of the post, and the green dome shade tilts on its own revolute hinge connected to the arm's neck.
captions.instruction: Generate a vintage banker's desk lamp with a round black base, a vertical brass post, a pivoting brass arm, and a green dome-shaped glass shade. The assembly should include a revolute joint connecting the arm to the post, and a second revolute joint connecting the shade to the arm's neck to allow realistic tilting.
captions.factory: Construct the lamp base as a flat Cylinder with a black material. Build the vertical post using a vertical Cylinder with a collar, assigning a brass/gold material. Model the pivoting arm using a combination of horizontal and curved cylinders connected by box-like hinge brackets. Create the green glass dome shade by taking a sphere or cylinder primitive, hollowing it out, and applying a semi-transparent green material. Define two revolute joints using the Articulation class: one at the top of the post to pivot the arm, and one at the shade connector to tilt the shade.
